components.description: User-facing web application and UI components
instructions: Keep state management predictable and isolated from presentation components.
Enforce strict client-side validation; never display unauthenticated debug or administrative panels.
Ensure full offline graceful degradation and user-friendly error banners.

components.description: Core REST and GraphQL API services
instructions: Validate all inputs at the controller boundary using strict schemas.
Never log sensitive credentials, authorization tokens, or raw user personal data.
Ensure database transactions are atomic and migrations are backwards-compatible.
